prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Approach, take, and process the object if it is visible, otherwise scan the area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = PickUpObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsRobotApproachingObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsRobotApproachingObject? THEN
			DO PickUpObject
	ELSE
		DO ProcessObject
	END
